YGG Play is the publishing arm of Yield Guild Games, focused on bringing casual crypto games to market by pairing studios with YGG’s Web3 gaming community, go-to-market playbooks, token launch support, creator network, and “degen” engagement mechanics. Its portfolio includes first-party games like LOL Land and Waifu Sweeper, second-party titles like Giga Chat Bat, and third-party ecosystem games such as Gigaverse, Roach Race, and Proof of Play. In short: YGG Play is building a crypto-native casual games publisher that helps studios turn simple, social, reward-driven games into durable Web3 communities and monetizable player networks.
